# SellSmart Property

> SellSmart Property is a South African platform that lets homeowners sell their own property without an estate agent, and lets buyers browse listings and make offers directly. Sellers list a property, manage enquiries, viewings and offers, handle the Offer to Purchase and document collection, and hand off to a conveyancer -- all in one place, without paying agent commission.

South Africa uses an Offer to Purchase (OTP) and conveyancer-led transfer process rather than a US-style closing; SellSmart Property's workflow (listing -> enquiries/viewings -> offer -> signed OTP -> document collection -> conveyancer -> registration) reflects that. Prices are in South African Rand (ZAR).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/): What SellSmart Property is and who it's for.
- [Browse Properties](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/browse): Live property listings, searchable by location, type and price.
- [How It Works](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/how-it-works): The end-to-end selling/buying process, step by step.
- [Pricing](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/pricing): Seller listing packages and what each includes.
- [Marketplace](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/marketplace): Directory of conveyancers and other property service providers.
- [About](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/about): Background on the company.
- [Contact](https://www.sellsmartproperty.co.za/contact): How to get in touch.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- This is a private-sale platform, not an estate agency -- SellSmart Property does not represent buyers or sellers in a transaction; it provides the tools they use to deal directly with each other.
- Everything under /sell, /dashboard, /buy and /buyer requires the visitor to be signed in as that role and has no public content -- don't link to those paths for a general audience.
- Individual property listings are seller-submitted and change frequently; treat prices/availability found on /browse or /property/:id pages as current-at-crawl-time, not authoritative for future dates.
